name: PrimeTechPy
description: A scientist and creative-tooling expansion for the existing Py identity: same Python companion, ten distinct uniforms and animation directions.

costumeDirections.name: Lab Coat Idle
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: White lab coat, amber safety goggles, compact flask holster, and a small IA patch.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: A calm breath, a quick instrument check, and a confident look up.

costumeDirections.name: Data Diver
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Teal data visor, compact air tank, and floating chart-bubble details.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Dives into a data stream and surfaces with a useful insight.

costumeDirections.name: Code Swimmer
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Developer headphones, a dark field laptop, and flowing syntax ribbons.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Swims through a current of code, edits a line, and ships the fix.

costumeDirections.name: Circuit Scout
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Compact scanner backpack, headlamp, and a glowing microchip badge.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Sweeps a circuit path and lights up the next connection.

costumeDirections.name: Debug Detective
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Small detective cap, magnifier, and a compact clue notebook.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Finds a clue, magnifies the defect, and marks the resolution.

costumeDirections.name: Research Presenter
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Portable presentation board, stacked research books, and a pointer.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Presents a chart and highlights the finding that matters.

costumeDirections.name: Sketch Coder
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Knit cap, stylus, sketch tablet, and a small blueprint notebook.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Sketches a quick line that transforms into a working prototype.

costumeDirections.name: Success Spark
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Bright lime spark details, a check badge, and a celebratory accessory.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: A bright sparkle burst, a happy nod, and a compact victory pose.

costumeDirections.name: Thoughtful Coil
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Soft field scarf, pocket notebook, and a subtle thought marker.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: A gentle coil, a deliberate pause, then a small resolved nod.

costumeDirections.name: Ocean of Syntax
costumeDirections.visualEnhancement: Deep-blue syntax current, luminous code fragments, and a flowing circular wave.
costumeDirections.signatureMotion: Glides through an ocean of syntax and brings a clean pattern to the surface.

animationPlan.runtimeStates: Map direction actions onto the shared Py runtime state contract; do not create a second pet identity.

ingestNote: The PrimeTechPy concept sheet exists in the conversation design history. Copy the approved source sheet into this package and slice its 10 directions into runtime-ready transparent frames before publishing.
